name: Flat-tailed Leaf-cutter Bee
desc: Flat-tailed Leaf-cutter Bee (Megachile mendica): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Megachile mendica, the flat-tailed leafcutter bee, is a species of solitary bee in the family Megachilidae. It was described by Ezra Townsend Cresson in 1878.
